title: Pan-Fried Dumplings with Soy Sauce
description: A simple and flavorful Chinese dish featuring pan-fried dumplings served with a side of soy sauce.
instructions: In a large pan, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and ginger and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the ground pork and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the soy sauce, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the pan-fried dumplings to the pan and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the bottoms are golden brown.
Serve the dumplings hot with additional soy sauce for dipping.
